name: The Broken Sigil
summary: Zengu sends you to recover sigils from the Stromgarde militia. Galen, son of Thoras Trollbane, broke the Sigil of Thoradin into eleven pieces, and you carry them to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.

sections.title: A Sigil in Pieces
sections.body: Three sigils guard Thoras Trollbane's tomb. You have taken the first from the Syndicate. The firmly entrenched Stromgarde militia holds the other two. Galen, Thoras' son, broke the Sigil of Thoradin into eleven pieces and scattered them among the defenders.

sections.title: To Tor'gan
sections.body: Zengu asks you to gather the pieces from Stromgarde's defenders. Then carry them to Tor'gan, the troll shaman at Hammerfall. He can bind them into a whole sigil.

sections.title: At Hammerfall
sections.body: Tor'gan says Zengu told him you needed help. He examines the pieces and judges the work manageable. All eleven are present, and the sigil's magical structure is easy to restore. Tor'gan tells you to close your eyes. Soon, he declares the Sigil of Thoradin whole again.

faq.q: What is the Sigil of Thoradin?
faq.answer: The Sigil of Thoradin is one of three sigils guarding Thoras Trollbane's tomb. Galen broke it into eleven pieces and scattered them among Stromgarde's defenders.
Galen, son of Thoras Trollbane, broke the Sigil of Thoradin into eleven pieces and scattered them among Stromgarde's defenders.

faq.q: Where are the sigil fragments held?
faq.answer: Stromgarde's defenders hold the pieces among the firmly entrenched militia guarding the remaining sigils.

faq.q: Who can bind the broken sigil?
faq.answer: Tor'gan, the troll shaman at Hammerfall, can bind the pieces into a whole sigil.

aliases: what quest comes before the broken sigil
faq.answer: It follows Sigil of Strom, where you recovered the first sigil from the Syndicate.
